system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application'

Resources:
  DatabaseSubnetGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup'
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'saas-app-subnet-group-${AWS::Region}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: 'Subnet group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster'
      SubnetIds: !GetAZs [ !Sub '${AWS::Region}' ]

  DatabaseCluster:
    Type: 'AWS::RDS::DBCluster'
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Sub 'saas-app-cluster-${AWS::Region}'
      Engine: 'aurora-postgresql'
      EngineMode: 'serverless'
      EngineVersion: '14.3'
      MasterUsername: !Sub 'saas_app_user_${AWS::Region}'
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub 'saas_app_password_${AWS::Region}'
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DatabaseSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt 'DatabaseSecurityGroup.GroupId'
      ScalingConfiguration:
        AutoPause: true
        MaxCapacity: 64
        MinCapacity: 4
        SecondsUntilAutoPause: 300

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup'
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: 'Security group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster'
      VpcId: !GetAtt 'VPC.Id'
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          CidrIp: '0.0.0.0/0'

  VPC:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPC'
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/16'

Outputs:
  DatabaseClusterIdentifier:
    Value: !Ref DatabaseCluster
    Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster identifier'
  DatabaseClusterEndpoint:
    Value: !GetAtt 'DatabaseCluster.Endpoint'
    Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster endpoint'
